text:
samir_devx: kicking off a quick sync — we're standardizing 'terraform micro-templates' for cloud partners (tiny opinionated modules + publishable quickstarts). goal: cross-cloud marketplace readiness + consistent CI smoke tests. @elaine_partners any stakeholder asks from partner success side?
elaine_partners: love this. main ask: modules should have a one-click deploy pattern for partners to demo in <30m and a tiny sample app. also include tagging + billing metadata by default. :+1:
toni_infra: technical constraints: modules must be single-responsibility, no more than 6 resources ideally, provide vars for region/instance_type/replicas. prefer HCL v0.13+ syntax and keep provider pinning minimal. we need a validation CI step that runs `terraform init && plan` on both amd64 and arm64 runners.
matt_sre: agree on CI. also add a lightweight smoke test that hits an HTTP health endpoint after apply and then destroys. we can reuse our existing smoke-runner image.
gina_eng: proposing a small example module layout in the repo: `modules/{service}/README.md`, `examples/{cloud}/{service}/` and a `publish.yml` workflow that runs lint/format/plan/smoke.
samir_devx: sketch of a minimal module usage to include in quickstart README (for starters):
```terraform
provider \"aws\" { region = var.region }
resource \"aws_instance\" \"app\" {
  ami           = var.ami
  instance_type = var.instance_type
  tags = merge(var.common_tags, { Name = \"micro-template-${var.env}\" })
}
```
make sure vars file examples include common_tags + billing_tag override.
jordan_ci: CI snippets:
- run tflint + fmt check
- terraform init && plan -out=plan.tfplan
- terraform apply -auto-approve
- run smoke test container against output.public_ip
- terraform destroy -auto-approve
we'll run matrix: { os: [ubuntu-latest], arch: [x86_64, arm64] }
toni_infra: for marketplace packaging we also need: license, maintainers list, minimal terraform-docs generated outputs and a `compat.yml` stating supported regions and architectures. include a `compat-check` script that verifies provider versions and required terraform version.
elaine_partners: partners want examples for GCP and Azure too. can we standardize variables names (region -> location for azure/gcp?) maybe just keep `location` aliased to `region` in docs to reduce copy/paste errors.
matt_sre: aliasing is fine. CI should run each cloud example in its own job to avoid cross-cloud creds mixing. use ephemeral test accounts.
samir_devx: open questions: who owns publishing to partner catalogs? and do we need a central curations repo vs letting partner repos publish?
elaine_partners: ops model: Redwood will maintain canonical micro-templates in `redwood/cloud-templates`, partners can fork + brand. for Marketplace we provide a publish-pack that partners can invoke. Redwood handles the initial publish and partner handles updates for their listing.
gina_eng: I'll prototype `publish.yml` that builds a zip with module + docs + terraform-docs output and uploads to a staging bucket. then infra-bot can trigger catalog ingestion.
infra-bot: [automation] staging artifact uploaded: s3://redwood-marketplace-staging/terraform/microtemplates/service-example-1784512345.zip (sha256: e3b0c442).
jordan_ci: timeline: prototype CI + smoke runs by EOD Wed, docs + sample apps by Fri, initial partner review next Tue. owners: samir_devx (overall), gina_eng (repo + CI), toni_infra (compat checks), elaine_partners (partner-facing docs).
samir_devx: perfect — I'll create the repo skeleton and PR the first micro-template (http-proxy) today. please drop short review notes in the PR and flag any non-blocking items with :eyes:.
elaine_partners: adding partner checklist items: support matrix, SLA expectations, contact info, example billing tag. I'll add a template doc under `partners/TEMPLATE.md`.
matt_sre: reminder: add a canary fallback policy in the README if the partner quickstart hits quota limits — point to Dedicated fallback docs.
samir_devx: noted. thanks all — follow-ups in PR 1784512345.
note: thread created to coordinate micro-template standard for partner marketplace quickstarts, includes CI/compat/packaging decisions
